200:t_1:90.en:
$$レド$$
「But... my body grew hot. Like when I watched $$エイミー$$ dance in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

200:t_1:91.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So you understand $$バサラ$$'s songs too, $$レド$$.」

200:t_1:93.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You could say you feel them. $$バサラ$$'s songs hit you right in the heart.」

200:t_1:94.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Question for Captain $$ガムリン$$. Is that a reference to the special energy waves he emits?」

200:t_1:95.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I think what $$チェインバー#pilot$$ detected was $$バサラ$$'s 《$$歌エネルギー$$》.」

200:t_1:96.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But regardless of any physical force like that, $$バサラ$$ sings songs that resonate in the heart.」

200:t_1:98.en:
$$アンディ$$
「For the record, I like $$シェリル$$'s singing just as much!」

200:t_1:99.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「I'd say $$ランカ$$! She's all 'Kira!', you know!」

200:t_1:100.en:
$$レド$$
「So those are the two we rescued yesterday...」

200:t_1:101.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Their songs are good ones too. If you get the chance, give them a listen.」

200:t_1:102.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...But in the end, Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and the others weren't at $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$.」

200:t_1:103.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Maybe they're being held somewhere else since they're VIPs...」

200:t_1:104.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But if that's the reason, aren't $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ VIPs too? They were being held in a special place, after all.」

200:t_1:105.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Even so, they must be different from people who are politically important.」

200:t_1:106.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ took the captured citizens into protection, but we still never found out what the Empire was after...」

200:t_1:109.en:
$$シュレード$$
「...$$ミレーヌ$$. You said earlier that $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ was being chased by the Empire.」

200:t_1:110.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Yeah... It seems they singled us out, because they chased us everywhere we went.」

200:t_1:111.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You mean the $$サイデリアル$$ went after $$バサラ$$ next, after $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$?」

200:t_1:112.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But neither Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ nor the captured people have anything to do with songs.」

200:t_1:113.en:
$$シュレード$$
「You're right... So this hypothesis has a hole in it...」

200:t_1:114.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But hey, if we win the next battle, the fight with the $$サイデリアル$$ will be over, right?」

200:t_1:115.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right. Once it is, we'll surely find out where the other captured people are, too.」

200:t_1:116.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Looking into why the $$サイデリアル$$ abduct citizens can wait until after that, I guess...」

200:t_1:119.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey, hey, $$アルト$$. I... want to hear $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ sing.」

200:t_1:120.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, $$エイミー$$. $$ランカ$$ seems to be a little tired.」

200:t_1:121.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「How is $$シェリル$$ doing?」

200:t_1:122.en:
$$アルト$$
「She's with $$ランカ$$. She must have had it rough in the detention facility herself, too...」

200:t_1:124.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Because of the $$ミカゲ$$ business, I heard those two will be acting with $c for the time being...」

200:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「But isn't that dangerous? When we're about to storm the enemy's home base, too...」

200:t_1:126.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then we just end the war with the Empire there. Once we do, the situation will settle down.」

200:t_1:128.en:
$$レド$$
「It's almost time for the meeting. Let's go.」

200:t_1:130.en:
$$レド$$
「...I'm the same as $$エイミー$$. I want to hear those two sing.」

200:t_1:133.en:
$$アルト$$
(Wait for us, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... With our own hands, we'll definitely end this fight.)

200:t_1:139.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes... Ever since he came back from the recon.」

200:t_1:140.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's got a sensitive side, that kid. That's probably why.」

200:t_1:141.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I get why he'd be shocked. I felt awful too when I heard Major $$カリーニン$$'s report.」

200:t_1:142.en:
$$シン$$
「But, how do I put it, um... I feel like there's something more than that.」

200:t_1:143.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$宗介$$ and the others are keeping an eye on him for now, but $$セツコ$$, do you and the others have any idea?」

200:t_1:144.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I think $n can feel it too. The Empire's Reactors.」

200:t_1:145.en:
$$ランド$$
「Figures. I bet that $$バルビエル$$ and $$尸空#pilot$$ are at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

200:t_1:146.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and $$スメラギ$$ predict the same thing, from a strategic standpoint.」

200:t_1:147.en:
$$シン$$
「Well, naturally. They know we're going to launch a decisive battle, and...」

200:t_1:148.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then we'll just crush them, the whole lot.」

200:t_1:149.en:
$$ランド$$
「$n must think so too. I bet he's made up his mind by now.」

200:t_1:150.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think so too. He has the strength not to lose to despair.」

200:t_1:155.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Seeing that look on your face puts me a little at ease.」

200:t_1:156.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a Heat Smile trained by yours truly. Not bad, huh?」

200:t_1:157.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ doesn't seem too happy about it, though.」

200:t_1:159.en:
$n
「Don't worry, Miss $$スズネ$$. I could never pull off a smile that stifl... that hot.」

200:t_1:160.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey! What were you about to say just now, $n!?」

200:t_1:162.en:
$$ランド$$
「Why, you punk! Deep down you were laughing at your Master's smile, you trendy-generation brat!」

200:t_1:163.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think blaming $n for that is going too far.」

200:t_1:164.en:
$$ランド$$
「Not you too, $$セツコ$$... Maybe hot-blooded guys are just out of fashion these days...」

200:t_1:165.en:
$$メール$$
「No sweat, no sweat. To me, Darling is always on the cutting edge of fashion!」

200:t_1:166.en:
$n
「So there you have it, Miss $$スズネ$$. There's nothing to worry about.」

200:t_1:168.en:
$n
「Let's do it, Miss $$スズネ$$. For the sake of liberating Earth from the Empire, too.」
